grain_rationale: One source row is one scheduled flight leg departing a New York airport, so the grain is transaction. The profile reports row_count 166158 and duplicate_row_rate 0.0, so no exact duplicate rows exist and no roll-up is needed to make rows unique. No single profiled column reaches distinct_count 166158 (the largest are tail_number at 3825 and departure_hour_utc at 3439), so a column identifier is not available and identity is derived over flight_date, carrier_code, flight_number, origin_airport and sched_dep_hhmm: flight_date spans 181 days from 2013-01-01 to 2013-06-30, carrier_code has 16 values, flight_number 2994, origin_airport 3 (EWR, JFK, LGA) and sched_dep_hhmm 969, and all five columns have null_rate 0.0 so the tuple is always resolvable. Because duplicate_row_rate is 0.0, the identity tuple has no exact duplicate rows to absorb.

fields.name: flight_date
fields.description: Local calendar date of the scheduled flight, ranging from 2013-01-01 to 2013-06-30 across 181 distinct values with null_rate 0.0, and part of the flight leg identity tuple.

fields.name: carrier_code
fields.description: Two-letter operating carrier code with 16 distinct values such as 9E, AA, DL, UA and WN and null_rate 0.0, used as a dimension and as part of the flight leg identity.

fields.name: flight_number
fields.description: Carrier flight number stored as an integer (2994 distinct values from 1 to 8500, null_rate 0.0) that labels the leg rather than measuring it, so it is a dimension and part of the identity tuple.

fields.name: origin_airport
fields.description: Origin airport code limited to the three New York airports EWR, JFK and LGA with null_rate 0.0, and part of the flight leg identity.

fields.name: sched_dep_hhmm
fields.description: Scheduled local departure clock time encoded as HHMM (969 distinct values from 500 to 2359, null_rate 0.0); it is a time-of-day code that is not added across rows, so it is a dimension and part of the identity tuple.

fields.name: dest_airport
fields.description: Destination airport code with 100 distinct values such as ABQ, ATL and BNA and null_rate 0.0, labelling where the leg terminates.

fields.name: tail_number
fields.description: Registration of the aircraft flying the leg (3825 distinct values such as N10156 and N102UW); nullable with null_rate 0.009154, since some rows, including cancelled flights, carry no assigned tail number.

fields.name: is_cancelled
fields.description: Flag with distinct values false and true and null_rate 0.0 marking whether the scheduled leg was cancelled, used as a filtering dimension.

fields.name: dep_hhmm
fields.description: Actual local departure clock time encoded as HHMM (1291 distinct values from 1 to 2400); it labels a time of day rather than measuring a quantity, and it is nullable with null_rate 0.029388 because legs that never departed have no actual departure time.

fields.name: dep_delay_minutes
fields.description: Departure delay in minutes ranging from -33 (early) to 1301, an additive quantity compared and averaged across legs; nullable with null_rate 0.029388 for legs that never departed.

fields.name: arr_hhmm
fields.description: Actual local arrival clock time encoded as HHMM (1392 distinct values from 1 to 2400), a time-of-day code rather than a measure; nullable with null_rate 0.0307 for legs that did not arrive.

fields.name: sched_arr_hhmm
fields.description: Scheduled local arrival clock time encoded as HHMM (1134 distinct values from 1 to 2359, null_rate 0.0), a time-of-day code and therefore a dimension.

fields.name: arr_delay_minutes
fields.description: Arrival delay in minutes ranging from -86 to 1272, an additive quantity summed and averaged across legs; nullable with null_rate 0.032981 for legs with no recorded arrival.

fields.name: air_time_minutes
fields.description: Minutes airborne between 20 and 695, a quantity added and averaged across legs; nullable with null_rate 0.032981 for legs that did not complete a flight.

fields.name: distance_miles
fields.description: Great-circle distance of the leg in miles ranging from 80 to 4983 with null_rate 0.0, an additive quantity used for mileage totals.

fields.name: sched_dep_hour_local
fields.description: Local hour-of-day component of the scheduled departure with 19 distinct values from 5 to 23 and null_rate 0.0, a bucketing label rather than a measure.

fields.name: sched_dep_minute_local
fields.description: Local minute-of-hour component of the scheduled departure with 60 distinct values from 0 to 59 and null_rate 0.0, a label rather than a measure.

fields.name: departure_hour_utc
fields.description: UTC timestamp of the scheduled departure hour with 3439 distinct values from 2013-01-01T10:00:00 to 2013-07-01T03:00:00 and null_rate 0.0; all samples land exactly on the hour, so it timestamps each leg at hour resolution.

fields.name: carrier_name
fields.description: Full operating carrier name with 16 distinct values such as Delta Air Lines Inc. and JetBlue Airways and null_rate 0.0, a denormalized label for carrier_code.

fields.name: aircraft_manufacturer
fields.description: Manufacturer of the aircraft flying the leg (34 distinct values such as AIRBUS, BOEING and BOMBARDIER INC); nullable with null_rate 0.160426 because many tail numbers have no matching registry record.

fields.name: aircraft_model
fields.description: Aircraft model designation with 121 distinct values such as 172M and 550; nullable with null_rate 0.160426 for legs whose tail number is missing or unmatched in the aircraft registry.

fields.name: aircraft_manufacture_year
fields.description: Year the aircraft was built, 46 distinct values from 1956 to 2013; it is a numeric label of the airframe rather than an additive quantity, and it is nullable with null_rate 0.176531 where registry data is missing.

fields.name: aircraft_seat_count
fields.description: Registered seat capacity of the aircraft ranging from 2 to 450, summed across legs to express offered capacity; nullable with null_rate 0.160426 where the aircraft registry record is missing.

fields.name: aircraft_engine_type
fields.description: Engine type of the aircraft with six distinct values including Turbo-fan, Turbo-jet and Turbo-prop; nullable with null_rate 0.160426 for unmatched tail numbers.

fields.name: origin_airport_name
fields.description: Full name of the origin airport, limited to the three values John F. Kennedy International Airport, LaGuardia Airport and Newark Liberty International Airport with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: origin_municipality
fields.description: City of the origin airport with the two distinct values New York and Newark and null_rate 0.0, a denormalized geography label.

fields.name: origin_elevation_ft
fields.description: Field elevation of the origin airport in feet, a static airport attribute with only three distinct values (13, 18, 21) and null_rate 0.0, so it labels rather than measures the event.

fields.name: origin_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: Longest runway length at the origin airport in feet, a static airport attribute with three distinct values (7002, 11000, 14511) and null_rate 0.0, used as a label.

fields.name: dest_airport_name
fields.description: Full name of the destination airport with 99 distinct values such as Albany International Airport; nullable with null_rate 0.02089 where the destination code has no airport reference match.

fields.name: dest_municipality
fields.description: City of the destination airport with 95 distinct values such as Atlanta and Austin; nullable with null_rate 0.02089 for unmatched destination codes.

fields.name: dest_iso_region
fields.description: ISO region of the destination airport with 45 distinct values such as US-CA and PR-U-A; nullable with null_rate 0.02089 for unmatched destination codes.

fields.name: dest_elevation_ft
fields.description: Field elevation of the destination airport in feet (90 distinct values from 3 to 6606), a static airport attribute that labels rather than measures; nullable with null_rate 0.02089 for unmatched destination codes.

fields.name: dest_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: Longest runway length at the destination airport in feet (84 distinct values from 5076 to 16000), a static airport attribute used as a label; nullable with null_rate 0.02089 for unmatched destination codes.

fields.name: captured_at
fields.description: Ingestion capture timestamp with 16 distinct values between 2026-09-02T23:25:51 and 2026-09-02T23:26:06 and null_rate 0.0; it records load batching rather than when the flight occurred, so it is a dimension and not the event time.

category_description: One row is one scheduled flight leg departing a New York area airport (EWR, JFK or LGA) on a given local flight date at a given scheduled departure time, identified by the combination of flight date, carrier code, flight number, origin airport and scheduled departure clock time, and timestamped at the UTC departure hour. Each row carries the operational outcome of that leg (departure and arrival delay minutes, air time, distance, cancellation flag) together with denormalized carrier, aircraft and origin or destination airport attributes.
purpose: This mapping declares how the contracted silver table silver.silver_flights enters the gold unified event star as the flight_departures fact category: it names the event time column and its grain, declares the transaction grain and the derived identity tuple that makes one row one flight leg, and assigns every mapped column a dimension, measure or time role. Its consumer is the deterministic modeling engine, which reads this contract and emits the gold models; downstream analysts consume the generated fact through the engine's output rather than through this document.
usage: The proposal is rendered into an ODCS mapping contract draft, validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema, gated by the validator and datacontract lint, and reviewed and edited by a human before approval. Once approved it is an input to the modeling engine, which uses the identity tuple to key the fact, departure_hour_utc at hour grain to place events on the time spine, and the declared measures (dep_delay_minutes, arr_delay_minutes, air_time_minutes, distance_miles, aircraft_seat_count) as the additive columns of the category.
limitations: The mapping only names silver columns and their roles; it performs no transformation, no filtering and no renaming. It does not exclude cancelled legs even though is_cancelled is populated on every row and the delay, arrival and air-time columns are null for roughly 3 percent of rows (null_rate 0.029388 to 0.032981), so consumers must decide how to treat cancelled or diverted legs in their own aggregations. It does not repair the sparse aircraft registry enrichment (null_rate 0.160426 for manufacturer, model, seat count and engine type, 0.176531 for manufacture year) or the unmatched destination airport reference attributes (null_rate 0.02089), and it does not reconstruct timestamps from the HHMM clock-time codes, which remain integer dimensions. It declares no quality rules, classifications, service levels or ownership, which are review concerns outside a mapping contract.
